summary: Cost policies now explain themselves: each policy reports why it fires or waits, Waldur records what started each evaluation, who started it and which gate decided it, and policies and projects keep a version history. Resource API keys get clearer model rules, with an empty list meaning no models and * meaning every model, plus rotation by the key's assignee, one key per person per resource and site agent notification when a key changes hands. A new CUSTOMER.VIEW_REPORTING permission opens organization reporting to owners and readers, and runtime settings move from django-constance to a built-in settings store, with a migration that imports existing settings. The release also adds an MCP server skeleton, tighter checks in AI assistant tools, billing and event-log fixes, and further moves of the interface from Metronic and Bootstrap to shared Waldur UI components.

entries.title: Accessible names, keyboard access and contrast for shared components
entries.description: Previously, some shared components lacked accessible names, keyboard access or enough contrast. Now, icon buttons, selects, tags, badges, sidebars, edit buttons and upload areas have accessible names, keyboard access and enough contrast. The organization and project selects have aria-labels, and WCAG target-size and link-in-text-block violations are fixed.

entries.title: Ask for missing D&B identity fields inline during onboarding
entries.description: Previously, missing D&B identity fields during organization onboarding had to be completed elsewhere. Now, the onboarding form asks for missing identity fields inline and sends the full D&B identity. The profile prompt is kept only for missing names.

entries.title: Audit events for security-relevant actions
entries.description: Previously, several security-relevant actions did not create audit events. Now, events are emitted for these actions, including logins through SAML2, OIDC/social and Valimo, deleting an offering, policy changes, and actions in the core admin and organization/project views.

entries.title: Backend URL validation in serializers now runs
entries.description: BackendURLValidator was attached to serializers without being instantiated, so backend URL checks never ran. It is now instantiated, and URL validation runs in the marketplace, OpenStack, Rancher and VMware serializers. Invalid URLs that were accepted before are now rejected.

entries.title: British English language and US English source strings
entries.description: Previously, British English was not offered as a separate language, and source strings mixed spellings. Now, user-visible source strings and feature descriptions in the backend and frontend are spelled in US English, which CI checks. An en-GB locale is generated from them, and translatable model fields such as role descriptions and category titles gain en-GB variants.

actions.description: Database migrations add en-GB fields, including permissions 0034_role_description_en_gb and marketplace 0307_category_description_en_gb_category_title_en_gb_and_more, and update help texts in existing migrations.

entries.title: CUSTOMER.VIEW_ACCOUNTING permission gates Accounting
entries.description: Previously, no dedicated permission controlled access to the Accounting section of an organization. Now, the new CUSTOMER.VIEW_ACCOUNTING permission gates Accounting pages, credits, payments and payment profiles, and reporting access. Owners and roles cloned from the owner role get the permission and are treated as owners.

entries.title: Deliver event-consumer events to an HTTP webhook
entries.description: Previously, event consumers could not deliver events over HTTP. Now, an event consumer can be set up to deliver events to an HTTP webhook. Staff can create and manage webhook event consumers from the pub/sub admin page.

actions.description: Database migration logging 0030_eventconsumer_webhook_delivery adds webhook delivery fields to event consumers.

entries.title: Design tokens and waldur-ui form controls replace Bootstrap styling
entries.description: Previously, the frontend relied on Bootstrap form controls, Bootstrap --bs-* variables and Metronic colour helpers. Now, form inputs, selects and labels use waldur-ui components on a three-layer design token system, with standard layout utilities, font sizes and border radius. Bootstrap CSS that nothing uses is no longer generated, which makes the stylesheet 32% smaller gzipped. The offering search and breadcrumbs share one combobox. Visual regressions from the migration are fixed, including SCSS selectors and wrap breakpoints, brand colour on search and breadcrumb links, font weights, and the link colour in the dark Neumorphism login layout.

entries.title: Disable floating IPs on subnets without a router
entries.description: Previously, a floating IP could be selected for a subnet without a router, and the release option was shown when an instance had no floating IPs. Now, floating IPs are disabled for such subnets in the instance deployment form, and the destroy dialog hides the release option when there are no floating IPs.

entries.title: Draft a support ticket from a Matrix chat thread
entries.description: Previously, opening a support ticket from a Matrix chat conversation meant leaving the chat. Now, the bot can draft a support ticket from a Matrix chat thread. Users can review, edit and submit the draft from a card in the chat, and the message composer supports chat commands with a command popup and a commands dialog.

actions.description: Database migration matrix_chat 0013_ticket_drafts adds storage for ticket drafts.

entries.title: Edit an offering access endpoint
entries.description: Previously, an offering access endpoint could not be updated after creation. Now, an offering access endpoint can be updated through the API, governed by a new permission, and edited from the endpoints section of the offering.

entries.title: EU VAT calculation on invoices
entries.description: Previously, invoices did not calculate EU VAT. Now, organizations have VAT fields, including a private person flag. VAT rates are stored and can be refreshed with the new refresh_vat_rates management command, and VAT is calculated on invoices and shown in the invoice PDF. New EU VAT settings are available in marketplace administration, and the billing and details panels of an organization show the new fields.

actions.description: Database migrations add VAT fields to organizations (structure 0086_customer_vat_fields) and a VAT rate table (invoices 0033_vatrate).
Review the new EU VAT settings before invoices are generated.

entries.title: Invoice notifications go to an organization's invoice emails
entries.description: Previously, an organization could not define separate addresses for invoice notifications. Now, an organization can store invoice email addresses, and invoice notifications are sent to them. A notification is sent when the addresses change. The addresses appear in the contact panel of the organization, and organization export and import include them.

actions.description: Database migration structure 0087_customer_invoice_emails adds the invoice emails field to organizations.

entries.title: Join HOMEPORT_URL and link paths with exactly one slash
entries.description: Links built from HOMEPORT_URL and a path could end up with a doubled or missing slash. They are now joined with exactly one slash.

entries.title: Keep line breaks in plain-text issue descriptions and comments
entries.description: Line breaks in plain-text issue descriptions and comments were lost when displayed. They are now kept in issue details, comments and the expandable issue list row.

entries.title: Navigation, error and order status fixes
entries.description: The managed project and remote project detail pages are no longer shown as provider or organization tabs, and the organization profile is shown only once on the dashboard. Backend field errors keep the names of lifted response keys. A provider approval is shown as pending while the order waits for the project to start.

entries.title: Non-transactional viewset actions and multipart schema for file-list uploads
entries.description: Previously, every viewset action ran inside the request transaction, and endpoints that upload a list of files had no multipart schema. Now, a viewset action can opt out of the request transaction, and file-list uploads are described with a multipart schema in the generated API schema.

entries.title: Proposal, review and step counts per call and round
entries.description: Previously, no endpoint gave per-call statistics. Now, a call stats endpoint returns the number of proposals, reviews and workflow steps per call and round, along with totals and field descriptions.

entries.title: Recover from stale cached Keystone tokens during OpenStack pulls
entries.description: OpenStack pulls could fail when a cached Keystone token had gone stale. The session now recovers from stale cached tokens during pulls.

entries.title: Resource actions dialog tabbed by action group
entries.description: Previously, the Show all dialog for resource actions listed every action together, and some actions were duplicated. Now, the dialog has a tab for each action group, and duplicate pull and end-date actions are removed for marketplace and OpenStack resources.

entries.title: Separate feature toggles for OpenPortal sending and receiving portals
entries.description: Previously, the sending and receiving OpenPortal pages did not have their own feature toggles. Now, each side has its own toggle and its pages are gated on it. The shared OpenPortal pages are hidden when the portal plays neither side.

entries.title: Show a resource option as the limit of a usage-based component
entries.description: Previously, usage-based components showed no limit taken from a resource option. Now, an integer resource option can be configured to show as the limit of a usage-based component. The limit appears in resource details, provider resource lists and the project dashboard.

entries.title: Staff can accept a user invitation on behalf of a named user
entries.description: Previously, only the invited user could accept a user invitation. Now, staff can accept an invitation on behalf of a named user.

entries.title: Tabs, tables and button polish
entries.description: Previously, several tabs, tables and buttons were styled inconsistently. Now, tab count badges are neutral gray and the active tab's count is highlighted in the primary color. Line tab strips that do not scroll wrap. Tables in framed embedded tabs have a closed frame and square corners. In the proposal row, an empty reviews list drops only the tab strip, and the Reviews tab stays visible when reviews fail to load. Support buttons are tertiary with a headset icon. Other changes: table search height matches the buttons beside it, the first expandable column header is spaced like the other columns, items in the organization Add menu have icons, the Apply to round button is the same size as on My Proposals, and chart target lines stay inside the plot area.

entries.title: Transform offering option values before storing them
entries.description: Previously, option values were stored exactly as the user entered them. Now, offering options can define a transform that is applied to the value before it is stored, in marketplace orders and in proposals. Providers can configure and preview transforms in the option editor and when approving orders.

entries.title: Typed, masked input in date pickers
entries.description: Previously, dates were picked mainly from the calendar popup. Now, a typed, masked input is the main control of the date, date range and month pickers. The month and year dropdowns use library menus, and the month arrows are no longer covered by the caption. In the project create dialog, the start and end dates are checked against each other, with an inline error when the range is inverted.

entries.title: Validate resource end dates on set_end_date
entries.description: Previously, set_end_date did not validate the resource end date. Now, the API validates the end date. The termination date pickers in ordering, the end date dialogs, the bulk end date dialog and end date change requests follow the same rules.

entries.title: Validate the OIDC ID token against the provider's JWKS on login
entries.description: Previously, the ID token returned at login was not checked against the identity provider's JWKS. Now, the ID token is validated against the provider's JWKS on login, and identity providers have new issuer and JWKS URL fields.

actions.description: Database migration waldur_auth_social 0017_identityprovider_issuer_jwks_url adds issuer and JWKS URL fields to identity providers.

entries.title: Access guidance and no-result search rate for anonymous discovery chat
entries.description: Previously, the anonymous discovery chat had no access-guidance rules, and its KPIs did not show how often searches returned nothing. Now, the anonymous assistant follows access-guidance rules covered by new validation scenarios, and the anonymous chat KPI reports the rate of searches that returned no results.

actions.description: Database migration chat 0019_anonymouschatinteraction_search_outcome stores the search outcome of anonymous chat interactions.

entries.title: Assignees can rotate resource API keys, and one key per person per resource
entries.description: Previously, the person a resource API key was assigned to could not rotate it, and one person could hold more than one API key on the same resource. Now, the assignee can rotate the key, and the resource page offers them Rotate. A request for a second API key for the same person on the same resource is refused. The API keys tab appears on managed resources that have no keys yet, and the documentation describes when a resource starts with no API keys.

entries.title: Branded boot splash and a route loading bar
entries.description: Previously, the boot splash was not branded and had no slow-loading or error states, and nothing showed that a page was loading when moving between pages. Now, the boot splash is branded and has slow-loading and error states, it is shared with micro-apps as the waldur-boot-splash package, and a loading bar shows while a page loads.

entries.title: Built-in settings store replaces django-constance
entries.description: Previously, runtime settings were stored with django-constance. Now, Waldur stores them in a built-in settings store in the new configuration app, which has its own Django admin page and handles secret settings and overrides. A migration imports existing django-constance settings into the new store. The Matrix chat guide in the Helm chart now clears Matrix settings from whichever settings table exists.

actions.description: Database migrations configuration 0001_initial and 0002_import_constance_settings create the settings store and import the existing django-constance settings into it.

entries.title: Bulk invite no longer stalls on the same email across projects
entries.description: Bulk invitations stalled when the same email address was invited to several projects. They no longer stall.

entries.title: Chat tools enforce tool-set and role checks themselves
entries.description: Previously, tool-set and role checks were not enforced inside the AI assistant's chat tools. Now, each tool enforces them itself, including the account tools for user overviews, project resources, resource usage and paused resources, and the proposal reviewer's call insights tool.

entries.title: Check resource creation against the cost policy's own credit gates
entries.description: Resource creation was not checked against the cost policy's own credit gates. It is now checked against them.

entries.title: Cookie consent dialog no longer reopens after close or accept
entries.description: The cookie consent dialog reopened after it was closed or accepted. It now stays closed.

entries.title: Cost policies show why they fire or wait
entries.description: Previously, a cost policy did not report why it had or had not fired. Now, the API exposes a trigger_status for each cost policy that explains why it fires or waits. The cost policy lists show the status as a single badge and list the organization credit only once. The project's cost policy details, credit dashboard and policy watch view use the status, and what happens next says when a credit holds a policy back.

entries.title: CUSTOMER.VIEW_REPORTING permission for organization reporting
entries.description: Previously, there was no CUSTOMER.VIEW_REPORTING permission for granting a role access to organization reporting. Now, the permission exists and is granted to organization owners and readers by default. Organization reporting, including its landing page and organization selector, is shown to roles that hold it.

entries.title: Declare OpenStack instance server_group as nullable
entries.description: The API did not declare the OpenStack instance server_group field as nullable. It is now declared nullable.

entries.title: Dependency updates for advisories and scanner findings
entries.description: Previously, Waldur shipped backend dependency versions flagged by security advisories and OSV scans, and the frontend toolchain used versions with published advisories. Now, aiohttp is updated to 3.14.5 for security advisories, Pillow to 13.0.0, certifi to 2026.10.19 and pypdf to 6.21.2 for OSV scan findings. In the frontend development and test tooling, vitest is updated to 4.1.12 for GHSA-qxg6-89mg-rqv8 and GHSA-xp26-3454-mjgp, Storybook to 10.6.3 for GHSA-f2ph-cmg5-wxc8, and vite and markdown-it are updated to clear osv-scanner advisories.

entries.title: Empty API key model list means no models, and * means every model
entries.description: Previously, a resource API key's model list had no * value for every model, and an empty list did not mean no models. Now, an empty list means no models and * means every model, so an API client that sends an empty list grants no models. Resource model selections follow the same rule. API key dialogs and model selection fields have an All models checkbox, and the key list shows keys that have no models.

actions.description: Database migrations marketplace 0308_resource_api_key_all_models to 0312_resource_api_key_models_outdated_backfill update stored API key and resource model lists, make the API key model list non-nullable, and add and backfill a models-outdated marker on API keys.

entries.title: Event filters match events filed on project and organization feeds
entries.description: Event filters by UUID did not match events filed on a project's or an organization's feed. They now match them, and the project credits and access subnets history logs are read through the organization scope.

entries.title: Expand a project in the organization project list to see its resources
entries.description: Previously, the organization project list did not show a project's resources. Now, a project row can be expanded to list its resources.

entries.title: Fix landing page crash "Converting circular structure to JSON"
entries.description: The landing page could crash with "Converting circular structure to JSON". The crash is fixed.

entries.title: Fix proposal page crash for staff before the call loads
entries.description: The proposal page crashed for staff before the call had loaded. It now waits for the call without crashing.

entries.title: Header, breadcrumbs, modals and page layout move to Waldur UI and Tailwind
entries.description: Previously, the app header, breadcrumbs, modals and page layout were built on Metronic and Bootstrap. Now, the header uses the waldur-ui TopBar, breadcrumbs use the router-agnostic BreadcrumbTrail, modals come from waldur-ui instead of Bootstrap, and the page layout is built with React and Tailwind instead of Metronic body classes. The Sass colour layer, SVG icon helpers and dead SCSS are retired, and Stylelint rejects retired class selectors. Boolean columns such as Active in Roles and permissions use a shared BooleanField, and fetched table rows are kept in React Query only.

entries.title: Leave credit compensations out of a total limit's billed quantity
entries.description: Credit compensations were counted in a total limit's billed quantity. They are now left out of it.

entries.title: MCP server skeleton with personal access token authentication
entries.description: Previously, Waldur had no Model Context Protocol (MCP) server. Now, a new mcp app adds an MCP server skeleton that authenticates clients with personal access tokens and is started with the mcp_server management command.

entries.title: Open an offering's support request without its provider as organization
entries.description: A support request opened from an offering used the offering's provider as its organization. The request is now opened without it, and a test confirms that the caller can follow a request opened about an offering.

entries.title: Open maintenance windows shown as in progress
entries.description: Previously, an open maintenance window was not shown as in progress, and its badge shared a line with the resource name in the resource list. Now, an open window is shown as in progress, and its badge has a line of its own.

entries.title: Project hero navigation, affiliation date check and onboarding status labels
entries.description: Previously, the project hero bar behaved as tabs, the affiliation dialog accepted an end date before the start date, and onboarding verification status labels were not capitalized. Now, the project hero bar works as navigation, the affiliation dialog requires the start date to be before the end date, and onboarding verification status labels are capitalized.

entries.title: Project version history for staff and support
entries.description: Previously, Waldur did not keep a version history of projects. Now, it records project versions, and staff and support can open a project's version history from the project list's actions. Existing projects get an initial version from a data migration.

actions.description: Database migration structure 0088_backfill_project_initial_revisions records an initial version for each existing project.

entries.title: Readable titles, descriptions and sections for notification event groups
entries.description: Previously, notification event groups in the notification settings had no readable titles or descriptions. Now, each group has a readable title and description, and the groups are arranged in sections.

entries.title: Record what started a cost policy evaluation and which gate decided it
entries.description: Previously, a cost policy evaluation did not record what started it, who started it or which gate decided its outcome, and staff changes to project credits did not appear in the project's audit log. Now, each evaluation records what started it and who, and which gate decided it. Staff changes to project credits are shown in the project's audit log.

entries.title: Return a marketplace resource to OK when its backend recovers
entries.description: A marketplace resource did not return to the OK state when its backend recovered. It now does.

entries.title: Send ticket comments to the ticket's own backend
entries.description: Ticket comments were not always sent to the support backend the ticket belongs to. They are now routed to the ticket's own backend and fail gracefully when that backend cannot take them.

entries.title: Show nameless subnets by their CIDR
entries.description: Previously, the instance deployment network step and the create port dialog labelled subnets by name, which left subnets without a name unlabelled. Now, a subnet without a name is shown by its CIDR.

entries.title: Site agent is told when a resource API key changes hands
entries.description: Previously, the site agent was not told when a resource API key was reassigned to another person. Now, a change of a key's assignee is signalled to the site agent.

entries.title: SLURM QoS and partition on proposal resource requests
entries.description: Previously, proposal resource requests and call resource templates did not show the SLURM QoS and partition. Now, they show both.

entries.title: Tables page through rows they already hold and drop the pager on short lists
entries.description: Previously, tables whose rows were already loaded, such as invoice items, import previews and instance IP lists, did not page through those rows, and short lists still showed a pager. Now, these tables page through the rows they hold, and short lists show no pager.

entries.title: User audit log visibility and API token access for impersonating staff
entries.description: Previously, a user's Audit log tab and IP address column were shown to viewers who could not read them, and staff impersonating a user could not see the user's API token when it was concealed. Now, the tab and column are hidden from those viewers, and staff impersonating a user can see the token.

entries.title: Version history of cost policies
entries.description: Previously, Waldur did not keep earlier versions of a cost policy. Now, it keeps a version history of cost policies, which can be opened from a cost policy's actions, including in an offering's cost policies.

since_previous.description: Previously, the instance deployment network step and the create port dialog labelled subnets by name, which left subnets without a name unlabelled. Now, a subnet without a name is shown by its CIDR.

since_previous.title: Site agent is told when a resource API key changes hands
since_previous.description: Previously, the site agent was not told when a resource API key was reassigned to another person. Now, a change of a key's assignee is signalled to the site agent.

since_previous.title: SLURM QoS and partition on proposal resource requests
since_previous.description: Previously, proposal resource requests and call resource templates did not show the SLURM QoS and partition. Now, they show both.

since_previous.title: Tables page through rows they already hold and drop the pager on short lists
since_previous.description: Previously, tables whose rows were already loaded, such as invoice items, import previews and instance IP lists, did not page through those rows, and short lists still showed a pager. Now, these tables page through the rows they hold, and short lists show no pager.

since_previous.title: User audit log visibility and API token access for impersonating staff
since_previous.description: Previously, a user's Audit log tab and IP address column were shown to viewers who could not read them, and staff impersonating a user could not see the user's API token when it was concealed. Now, the tab and column are hidden from those viewers, and staff impersonating a user can see the token.

since_previous.title: Version history of cost policies
since_previous.description: Previously, Waldur did not keep earlier versions of a cost policy. Now, it keeps a version history of cost policies, which can be opened from a cost policy's actions, including in an offering's cost policies.
